text:
ellen-partnerships: FYI — Partner AtlasHW submitted a PO through the marketplace but it failed our ingestion because of the fulfillment_flag mismatch. finance rejects until we reconcile.

devin-sales: ugh, is this the "self-fulfilling" vs "platform-fulfillment" toggle again? we thought we nailed that last quarter. @ashley-ops any quick workaround? :thinking_face:

ashley-ops: looks like the marketplace is sending fulfillment_flag=SELF but AtlasHW's onboarding pipeline expects FULFILL_BY_MARKET. The PO landed in our SFTP with a VAT holder header missing. finance needs VAT info for EU orders.

leah-legal: tagging legal because the partner contract has a clause allowing self-fulfillment for hardware partners if they provide export docs. do we have those from AtlasHW?

ellen-partnerships: they uploaded docs to their vendor portal but the marketplace portal didn't pass the docs through the EDI payload. payload sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "po_id": "PO-78342",
  "fulfillment_flag": "SELF",
  "items": [{"sku": "AHW-RTXA500", "qty": 4}],
  "tax": {"country": "DE", "vat_number": ""}
}
```

raj-engineering: quick note — our EDI consumer strips attachments if fulfillment_flag==SELF because older partners used external invoices. we can flip that but need a hotfix. changing default could break 3rd-party flows.

devin-sales: customer is waiting to close the marketplace deal today. partner says they can re-emit the PO with the platform flag but that requires manual reissue on their side which will take 2 hours. what's the fastest path to blue-green the change? @raj-engineering

raj-engineering: fastest is a config toggle on the EDI consumer to treat SELF as pass-through for attachments (15-30m deploy with tests). but we need legal sign-off to accept vendor-signed export docs in the marketplace pipeline.

leah-legal: I can greenlight accepting vendor export docs conditionally if we require a signed attachment and hash verification. need partner to include docs and a sha256 header in the EDI envelope. sample header: `x-doc-sha256: <hex>` . thats our audit trail requirement.

ashley-ops: operationally doable. i can deploy the toggle and add a consumer check for `x-doc-sha256`. partner just needs to resend with that header and VAT number filled.

devin-sales: i'll ping AtlasHW now and ask for a re-emit with VAT and the sha header. if they can't, ask them to set fulfillment_flag=PLATFORM so the marketplace handles fulfillment.

essen-partnerships: (typo-alert) meant to write ellen-partnerships: Also, add to the deal notes: require partner to acknowledge we will not accept liability for customs if they remain SELF-fulfilling.

ellen-partnerships: noted. i'll add that to the commercial worksheet and update the PO conditions.

staging-bot: deploy started by raj-engineering at 2234567896 — EDI consumer config toggles: allow_self_attach=true, require_x_doc_sha=true.

raj-engineering: deploy succeeded, consumer will validate x-doc-sha256 and pass attachments through for SELF. monitoring on ingestion for next 30m. :white_check_mark:

devin-sales: AtlasHW says they re-emitted PO with vat_number=DE123456789 and header `x-doc-sha256: a3f4...` — can we confirm ingestion?

ashley-ops: confirmed — PO-78342 ingested, attachments stored in secure bucket, finance notified. closing the escalation. :tada:

ellen-partnerships: great work team. will follow up with a short postmortem and update the partner onboarding checklist to include `x-doc-sha256` and explicit fulfillment_flag mapping.
